examples.text: Get a Month On Us, plus up to $200 back.
examples.rule: Do not invent an expiry or convert an upper limit to guaranteed value.

examples.text: GET IT WITH ALL-IN. Hulu On Us. $11.99/mo value
examples.rule: Included entitlement; stated value must not populate payable price.

examples.text: New York residents may qualify for our $15/month Home Internet plan.
examples.rule: Keep regional qualification; income conditions are unknown from this text alone.

examples.text: Just $30/month each for a student phone plan and 5G home internet.
examples.rule: Preserve per-component unit, student eligibility and mixed products; do not invent a total.

examples.text: Get a FREE Ooma Telo Air device (a $129.99 value) when you sign up for Ooma Premier ($9.99/month) for 18 months.
examples.rule: Attach the 18-month paid-service condition and partner product.

examples.text: TECHEDGE SUITE. 24/7 live assistance with video support. $8.25/mo. value
examples.rule: Do not convert stated value into a separate service charge.

examples.text: Save your family up to $1000/yr when you bundle.
examples.rule: Full plan/line/autopay conditions must be linked from the associated description and terms.

examples.text: Switch to T-Mobile 5G Home Internet and get your gateway the same day with free DoorDash delivery.
examples.rule: Specific switch-linked concession; no invented dollar value.

examples.text: Get exclusive perks for each eligible home internet line. Find them every Tuesday in the T-Life app.
examples.rule: Ongoing perks program, not evidence of individual current offers.

examples.text: Customer satisfaction recognized by J.D. Power.
examples.rule: Attributed claim only; not an independently verified award.

examples.text: Your monthly plan price is guaranteed for five years under the included Price Guarantee terms.
examples.rule: Duration is not a source-stated calendar expiry.
No evidence of a promotional concession; retain price as an ordinary listing.

examples.text: Get free streaming for 3 months when you switch.
examples.rule: Timed signup incentive, unlike an ongoing included subscription.
Insufficient linkage; keep for review rather than manufacture a proposition.
